name: block-party-skyway
title: Block Party: Skyway
summary: A 3D platformer in the sky. Explore every island, then race through it.
description:
Block Party: Skyway is a 3D platformer across a chain of floating islands.
Run, jump, long jump, dive, ground pound and kick off walls to find stars
and hidden gems, then race the courses against the clock and your own
ghost.

- Adventure: explore each island at your own pace, help the islanders and
  open the Skyway's rainbow bridges with the stars you find
- Speedrun: every course Adventure finds is a time trial with medals, a
  clock to the hundredth and your best run's ghost beside you
- A calm camera that sits behind and above and turns gently, with comfort
  settings for turn speed, field of view and a follow-behind mode
- Made for controllers and handhelds, fully playable with a mouse and
  keyboard
